title: Routed Graph Handoff: Adaptive Format Selection for Multi-Agent LLM Delegation
abstract: arXiv:2608.25277v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems coordinate through natural-language messages that consume 40--60\% of their token budget. Replacing these with structured graphs reduces cost but fails on tasks requiring adaptive reasoning. We propose \textbf{Routed Graph Handoff}, where a lightweight LLM router (155 tokens, 0.15\% overhead) selects between a typed dependency graph and natural language for each delegation. On four benchmarks (1,050+ trajectories), the routed system matches or exceeds NL-only on every task: \textbf{+12.7\,pp} on $\tau$-retail at 3.2$\times$ compression ($p{<}0.01$), \textbf{+8.7\,pp} on BrowseComp at 2.2$\times$ compression ($p{<}0.05$), and parity on BFCL and AppWorld. Without the router, graph-only delegation regresses 14.6\,pp on AppWorld; the router eliminates this at near-zero cost. translated_title: 路由图交接：多智能体LLM委派的自适应格式选择
translated_abstract: 多智能体LLM系统通过自然语言消息进行协调，这些消息消耗了40%-60%的令牌预算。用结构化图替换这些消息可以降低成本，但在需要自适应推理的任务上会失败。我们提出了“路由图交接”，其中轻量级LLM路由器（155个令牌，0.15%开销）在每次委派时在类型化依赖图与自然语言之间进行选择。在四个基准测试（1,050多条轨迹）上，路由系统在每个任务上均达到或超过仅使用自然语言的表现：在τ-retail上提升+12.7个百分点，压缩率3.2倍（p<0.01），在BrowseComp上提升+8.7个百分点，压缩率2.2倍（p<0.05），在BFCL和AppWorld上持平。没有路由器时，仅图委派在AppWorld上回归14.6个百分点；路由器以近零成本消除了这一退化。需要图感知的执行器提示：没有解释指导的相同模式不会带来任何增益。预言机分析揭示了8.6个百分点中的...
tldr: 本文提出路由图交接方法，通过轻量级路由器在结构化图与自然语言间自适应选择委派格式，在保持性能的同时大幅压缩令牌消耗，并消除纯图方法的退化问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Routed Graph Handoff, which uses a lightweight router to adaptively select between structured graphs and natural language for multi-agent delegation, achieving performance parity or gains while significantly reducing token overhead and eliminating graph-only regression.
